corrections.statement: D27's inherited/knocked-out objects are simulated integer counters and a boolean flag of the T2/T3 simulator Sim, not acquired program objects; the discrete +0.25 continued-over-reset advantage is schedule-derived (2 method_acq tasks x 11 post-epoch-1 epochs = 22 of 88 tasks), not evidence of population-level abstraction discovery; the knockout cannot alone establish native method acquisition, actual future-search improvement, or a negative against every implemented OCM learner (src/ocm/learning/methods.py is a genuine native learner that changes candidate enumeration).

FOF1 and the held-out T3 share the same t3_draw/run_t3 generator (future_family.py lines 62-65); related/unrelated/harmful keys are different frozen parameter draws through ONE generator; the 0.0135 vs 0.0194 mean-relative-drop contrast is a contrast between frozen proxy draws, not an identified structural-relatedness effect, and must not be used to infer that future ecologies lack transferable regularities.

The pure-repeat Q* of about 80.7 is a projection off the frozen grid, not an observed crossover; the earlier registered rho-range prediction (rho* in [0.51, 0.905]) was refuted at the swept scope (30 worlds x 5 rho x Q<=32, NO_CROSSOVER_ANYWHERE_OFF_RHO1); repeated-query benefits still need comparison with a parent allowed ordinary caching/persistence; the result tests this abstraction mechanism and cost model, not every developmental learner.

preserves: All raw D27/D29 results are preserved with every original field and number unchanged. Every edit in this amendment is append-only (new keys, new dated annotation lines); no existing field was modified, no verdict relabelled positive, no raw result discarded.
does_not_reopen: No merged verdict is reopened; scope clarifications only.
